company.description: Buseet is a shared mobility startup focusing on fixing the daily commute for whole family members. Buseet is a one-step booking service that allows users to use their saved locations for their daily rides. They can search for nearby stations to find the best ride for them, and they can recommend plans based on their bookings to save even more time.
